newsitem.title: USA: ESS Technology names Herbert Martin COO.
newsitem.headline: ESS Technology names Herbert Martin COO.

text.p: ESS Technology Inc said Monday it had appointed Herbert Martin as president and chief operations officer of the company.
The company said Martin would replace Fred Chan as president.
Chan would remain as chief executive officer and chairman of the board of directors, it added.
The company said Martin had served on the board since July 1996 and worked as a consultant and adviser to the company during the last three months.
ESS Technology Inc, headquartered in Fremont, California, designs, develops and markets integrated mixed signal semiconductors and program software.
